checks.text: The page shows the heading "Morse Code Translator".
Typing "SOS" in the input pane and clicking the button "Convert" shows "…–– …–– …––" in the output pane.
Clicking the button "Swap" moves "…–– …–– …––" to the input pane and "SOS" to the output pane.
Typing "HELLO" in the input pane and clicking "Convert" shows "…… .–. .–. –––" in the output pane.
Typing "123" in the input pane and clicking "Convert" shows "––––– ––––– …––––" in the output pane.
After converting "SOS", clicking the button "Copy" copies "…–– …–– …––" to the clipboard.
After converting "SOS" and "HELLO", the history list shows two items containing "SOS" and "HELLO".
Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all items from the history list.
Reload keeps the history items "SOS" and "HELLO" visible in the history list.
